d: We are currently seeking passionate and dynamic sales professionals who take pride in delivering exceptional customer service and providing creative solutions to our guests.

As a Senior Sales Manager, you will be responsible for driving sales activities and maximizing business opportunities within your designated market segment. The role involves implementing strategic sales plans and achieving revenue targets through effective client relationship management.
q: You should hold a degree in Sales, Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field, with a minimum of two years of post-graduate experience, preferably within the hospitality industry.

The ideal candidate will be computer literate with excellent presentation, negotiation, and interpersonal skills. Strong written and verbal communication skills in English are essential, while proficiency in additional languages will be considered an advantage.

The successful candidate will possess a strong customer-focused approach, a proactive attitude, and a passion for achieving results. You should demonstrate flexibility, professionalism, and integrity in all interactions with both clients and colleagues.
A proven track record of meeting and exceeding sales targets is essential, along with the ability to identify opportunities, develop account plans, and successfully implement sales strategies.
This role requires a highly motivated sales professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment and is committed to delivering exceptional service while driving business growth
r: li
Ensure comprehensive coverage of your assigned portfolio by maintaining strong relationships with key decision-makers and department heads to achieve sales targets and maximize productivity.
li
Implement and execute sales strategies and action plans to meet and exceed established business goals.
li
Develop proposals, negotiate rates, and secure transient and group business opportunities for the property.
li
Generate and promote sales leads across the Rotana network within your assigned market.
li
Monitor market trends and competitor activities, providing regular feedback on changing market conditions through sales calls, telephone prospecting, and direct marketing initiatives.
li
Establish and maintain accurate account files while supporting the effective management of the accounts database.
li
Adhere to approved sales strategies during negotiations and maximize upselling opportunities whenever possible.
p
This role is ideal for a results-driven sales professional with excellent relationship-building, negotiation, and communication skills, and a passion for delivering outstanding guest experiences

d: We are seeking a dedicated and skilled Service Technician-2 to join our team at TK Elevator Almoayyed W.L.L based in Manama. This role is a vital part of our Field Services (SER Fld) unit, directly contributing to the maintenance, repair, and performance optimization of our elevator systems, ensuring safety and reliability for our customers.

The Service Technician-2 is responsible for delivering high-quality technical service and support related to elevator equipment and related systems. This includes troubleshooting, repairing, maintaining, and inspecting elevator components to meet company and regulatory standards. The role demands a hands-on approach, technical expertise, and strong problem-solving skills to address complex mechanical and electrical challenges efficiently.
q: Relevant technical diploma or certification in mechanical, electrical, or electronic engineering fields.
Proven experience in elevator or automated system maintenance and repair.
Strong mechanical aptitude and troubleshooting skills.
Knowledge of safety standards and regulations applicable to elevator equipment.
Ability to work from heights and in confined spaces safely and effectively.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to work well in a team and interact professionally with clients.
Valid driving license and willingness to travel within assigned regions as necessary.
r: li
Perform routine maintenance, inspection, and repairs on elevators, escalators, and moving walkways in accordance with company and safety standards.
li
Diagnose malfunctions using appropriate diagnostic tools and implement effective solutions in a timely manner.
li
Ensure compliance with local safety regulations and company policies during all service operations.
li
Document service reports and communicate findings and recommendations clearly to supervisors and clients.
li
Collaborate with the service team and other departments to enhance service delivery and customer satisfaction.
li
Maintain inventory of tools and spare parts, ensuring readiness for all service calls.
li
Participate in ongoing training and development to keep current with technological advances in elevator systems and safety procedures.
x: Joining TK Elevator Almoayyed W.L.L means becoming part of a forward-thinking and supportive company known for its commitment to innovation, safety, and employee development. We provide opportunities for professional growth, access to advanced technology training, and a collaborative work environment where your expertise contributes to meaningful projects impacting urban mobility and safety.

If you are passionate about delivering exceptional service, advancing your technical skills, and contributing to a safer community through reliable elevator systems, we encourage you to apply for this rewarding position.
